messages:
laura-partnerops: Heads-up — OrbitRack just told us one pallet of EU-targeted GPUs (Dedicated reserve batch) got split at customs and part of it is being held. This will impact reserved capacity for eu-ded-1 for the first week of April.

ajay-logistics: Copy. Where is it held? can we reroute from the UK staging pool? :eyes:

karen-orbit: OrbitRack here — one container diverted to Rotterdam for customs inspection, clearance ETA ~48h if docs OK. We have a small UK buffer of 8 units we can release immediately, but it requires reassigning serials and updating the reservation mapping on your side.

laura-partnerops: Thanks @karen-orbit. If we take the UK buffer, which customers/reservations will be impacted down the line? Need to understand swap risk.

karen-orbit: It'll leave our UK buffer at 2 units for other marketplace commits. We can guarantee the 8 for you but no further holds. We can also prioritize the Rotterdam manifest once cleared.

nate-runtime: Quick question for the infra side — if we have to temporarily lose 8 GPUs from eu-ded-1, can we stagger allocation so active customers degrade gracefully? I can push a rollout: reduce default batch size and switch heavier routes to q4_0 quantized model variants for a 10–15% perf hit but preserve throughput. Would need a 30-min maintenance window.

maria-product: That's a sensible mitigation. Which routes would you switch? We should only touch non-SLA customers first. Also we need a comms draft for affected Dedicated customers.

omar-finance: Also flagging that if shipments slide beyond 72h we should consider pro-rated credits for impacted Dedicated tenants. I'll model the cost hit.

ajay-logistics: Operationally we can do the reassign now. Laura, if you approve I'll run the reservation remap: 

```
reserve-manager assign --resv eu-ded-1 --source UK-stash --qty 8 --notes "rotterdam-hold-mitig" 
```

ajay-logistics: That will change serials for those 8 units in the reservation table — customers will still have capacity but serials differ.

laura-partnerops: Approve the reassignment. @nate-runtime coordinate the 30-min config rollout and list which customer routes to flip. Maria please draft a short support note to customers on Dedicated eu-1 saying "temporary allocation shuffle, no SLA change expected; we're monitoring".

nate-runtime: Will do. Plan: 1) create canary route to 2 nodes with q4_0, 2) run perf smoke, 3) flip non-SLA routes, 4) monitor latency dashboard for 1h. ETA 45m to prep.

maria-product: Drafting message now, will post to support and cc partnerships.

evan-legal: Heads-up — if any contracts reference specific serial ranges for compliance, we need to confirm before reassigning. Laura, can you confirm none of the impacted tenants have serial-specific clause?

laura-partnerops: Good catch. I checked — only one enterprise tenant (acme-inc) had a serial-specific clause but their reserved pool is outside this batch. Confirmed safe to reassign.

karen-orbit: We're standing by to update the manifest once you confirm reassign. If Rotterdam clearance completes faster we can also expedite a follow-up shipment to top the UK buffer back to 8.

omar-finance: I'll share a quick runbook for credit thresholds if the delay goes >72h.

laura-partnerops: OK executing now. @supplybot tag:reservation_change 1718501234 by laura-partnerops

supplybot: reservation_change recorded: resv=eu-ded-1 qty_moved=8 source=UK-stash actor=laura-partnerops timestamp=1718501260

ajay-logistics: Reassign done and serials updated in ERP. Manifest note: 

```
PO: ORB-2026-4129
moved_qty: 8
from: UK-stash
to: eu-ded-1
note: rotterdam-hold-mitig
```

nate-runtime: Canary looks good, no perf regressions beyond expected. Flipping 4 non-SLA routes now.

maria-product: Comms sent to affected customers + support playbook.

laura-partnerops: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread open until Rotterdam clears — will update. :thumbsup:
